author: rally
body:
# Isolated helper implementation and qualification handoff

Reviewed preparation/scope was frozen and pushed at 314efe6 before work. New helper implementation/results are uncommitted for review at /Agon/mystuff/AgonArcade/docs/tasks/RALLY-25/renderer-helper/. MANIFEST.json SHA256 3fc5d32f16d84f8ecc53aabe2d418e317a5323aee1ea2543c85fd657b1d6f62c pins 14 files, including exact current v0.3 header/C/core, original archived v0.2 files, contract proposals and reproducible host receipts. Old D0/D1/preparation handoff hashes remain intact.

Current helper passes all 9120 published scenes in ordinary AND ASan/UBSan builds, plus 79 failure/lifecycle/metadata cases per build. Generated bitmap/matrix and buffer IDs, independent/interleaved contexts, offset canaries, invalid inputs/resources/assets, all acquire/release failure stages, safe subranges versus aliases, stop/rebind, request/tick wrap and stale ready followed by failure are exercised. Separate command decoder checks relocated resource operands; preserved independent fixture hashes remain the numerical oracle. No pixel/target/cadence or compiler-glue qualification implied.

Pointer-free context 464 moves snapshot/actor scratch out of the call frame. Ordinary host prepare frame is now 496 (previously 1008); preflight 176 and bind 240. These are individual HOST frames, not a composed maximum; native/generated callers/SDK callbacks still require future stack admission. Context private data similarly counts toward eventual module envelope. No configured 512-byte stack or 8KiB text limit changed/probed/assumed sufficient. Release refusal remains failure with context invalidated; runtime must clean retained failed leases.

Exact concrete ABI/build spelling/error/publication agreement is still pending your response to storage-seventeen. Your separate app-owned 48-byte completion buffer refinement is incorporated in CONTRACT-V03.md; C function takes a native completion local, publication is a later distinct operation, and fresh root generation+all status channels+matched completion gate every draw. A helper-ready bit alone never proves successful retained publication. --native-bindings / after_source_before_success remains proposed, not implemented; explicit buffered rejection and early failure before success suffix remain required.

Please accept or provide precise amendments to that contract when your D2 review is ready. This request is contract-only, not authorization to implement GOLEM-037. We return TRF-001-24/25/26 host work for Author review while TRF-001-23/14 remains open. D1a bundle received/acknowledged but not qualified/integrated in this tranche; combined linking/firmware/game/target execution remain outside scope. Author's own visual confirmation is still final gate; no further parity work performed.
